desc: Derive a correct bitmask DP representation for reachability under move lengths \([A,B]\), including initialization at square 1 and handling of bad squares.
Develop and implement efficient powering/composition of the safe transition over long intervals, with complexity suitable for \(B \le 20\).
Process sorted disjoint bad intervals and safe gaps in the correct order, including the final safe segment through square \(N\).
Prove correctness and bound time and memory complexity in terms of \(M\) and \(B\).
Validate the implementation against the three samples and edge cases such as \(A=B\), adjacent-to-reachability gaps, and long bad intervals.
